objective: Receive finished goods from a plant, a sales truck or a supplier and post them correctly in SAP.

screens.purpose: Set context: inbound is where stock accuracy starts.
screens.visual_concept: Full-bleed photo of a trailer backing into a loading bay, navy overlay, module title left-aligned with a short red accent bar.

imagery.description: Trailer reversing into warehouse dock door 4, dusk lighting
imagery.alt_text: A delivery trailer backing into a warehouse loading bay

screens.purpose: Show the three inbound sources and let the learner explore each.
screens.visual_concept: Warehouse floor plan from above with three glowing entry points: plant shuttle, sales truck, supplier truck; each a white icon tile.

imagery.description: Top-down warehouse map with three labelled dock entry points
imagery.alt_text: Warehouse map showing three receiving sources: plant, sales truck and supplier

screens.on_screen_text: Three ways goods arrive. Select each one.

screens.purpose: Walk through receiving from the plant: check, offload, sign, post.
screens.visual_concept: Four-step horizontal flow of icon tiles connected by dotted lines; each step lights up as the narrator reaches it.

imagery.description: Clipboard check, forklift, signature, SAP screen icons

screens.on_screen_text: Check → Offload → Sign & stamp → Post in SAP

screens.visual_concept: Close-up photo of a crushed shrink-wrapped pallet; the learner chooses what the checker does next.

imagery.description: Damaged pallet with torn shrink wrap and dented cases
imagery.alt_text: A pallet with torn wrapping and dented cases

screens.on_screen_text: The pallet is damaged. What do you do?

screens.purpose: Check understanding of the supplier mismatch rule.
screens.visual_concept: Clean question card on a light background with a small supplier-truck icon in the corner.
